cocktails.name: Spice 75
cocktails.instructions:
Gently warm 60g golden caster sugar in a pan with 30ml water and 1 tbsp allspice. Cook gently until the sugar has dissolved, then leave the mixture to cool. Strain through a sieve lined with a coffee filter (or a double layer of kitchen paper).

Pour 60ml of the spiced syrup into a cocktail shaker along with 200ml rum and 90ml lime juice. Shake with ice and strain between six flute glasses. Top up with 600ml champagne and garnish each with an orange twist.

cocktails.name: Vampiro

Bartenders may first "rim" the glass with Kosher Salt, which is done by placing a layer of Kosher Salt on a chopping board, moistening the glass' rim with lime juice or water, and then placing the upside down glass rim onto the Kosher Salt, so that the salt sticks to the moistened rim. The second step is to fill half the glass with ice and add one or two shooter glasses full of high quality Tequila. The next stage is to add the flavouring elements. This is done by squeezing a fresh lime into the glass, adding a few grains of salt, adding citrus-flavoured soda pop, until the glass is 4/5 full, and then adding spicy Viuda de Sanchez (or orange juice, lime juice and pico de gallo). The final step is to stir the ingredients so that the flavours are properly blended.

Prepare all the ingredients on the counter to be able to work well and quickly, especially the cream and egg white.

Pour all the ingredients into a shaker.

Shake vigorously for 1 minute: cream and egg white must be mixed perfectly, so don't rush.

Now open the shaker and put some ice and shake for 1-2 minutes. It depends on how long you can resist!

Pour into a highball glass, add a splash of soda and garnish to taste.

Ramos Gin Fizz was once drunk as an invigorating drink or even as a breakfast, try it as an aperitif and after dinner and you will discover a little gem now lost.

cocktails.name: Ramos Fizz
cocktails.glass: strain into a highball glass, top up with soda.
cocktails.instructions:
Pour all ingredients except soda water in a cocktail shaker with ice.
Shake for two minutes, double strain in a glass, pour the drink back in the shaker and hard shake without ice for one minute.
Strain into a highball glass, top up with soda.
NOTE: The drink was invented by Henry Ramos in 1888, at his bar Meyer’s Table d’Hôtel Internationale in New Orleans. The Ramos Fizz was originally shaken for 12 minutes by a crew of 30 bartenders who passed the shaker from one to another.

cocktaildb:aloha_fruit_punch.name: Aloha Fruit punch
cocktaildb:aloha_fruit_punch.instructions: Add 1/4 cup water to ginger root. Boil 3 minutes. Strain. Add the liquid to the guava, lemon and pineapple juices. Make a syrup of sugar and remaining water. Cool. Combine with juices and pineapple. Chill throroughly.

cocktaildb:rum_punch.name: Rum Punch
cocktaildb:rum_punch.instructions: Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl and serve.

cocktaildb:daiquiri.name: Daiquiri
cocktaildb:daiquiri.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled cocktail glass.

iba::daiquiri.name: Daiquiri
iba::daiquiri.instructions: In a cocktail shaker add all ingredients. Stir well to dissolve the sugar.\nAdd ice and shake. Strain into chilled cocktail glass.
iba::daiquiri.glass: add ice and shake. strain into chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:masala_chai.name: Masala Chai
cocktaildb:masala_chai.instructions: Bring 2 cups of water to boil. Add all the ingredients and boil again for about 15 seconds. Let stand for a minute. Warm milk in a pot. Filter tea into cups. Add milk and sugar. That's IT.

cocktaildb:dirty_martini.name: Dirty Martini
cocktaildb:dirty_martini.instructions:
Pour the vodka, dry vermouth and olive brine into a cocktail shaker with a handful of ice and shake well.
Rub the rim of a martini glass with the wedge of lemon.
Strain the contents of the cocktail shaker into the glass and add the olive.
A dirty Martini contains a splash of olive brine or olive juice and is typically garnished with an olive.

cocktaildb:bellini_martini.name: Bellini Martini
cocktaildb:bellini_martini.instructions:
Add ice cubes to shaker.
Add vodka.
Add peach schnapps.
Add peach nectar.
Shake.
Strain into glass.
Add lemon twist peel.

cocktaildb:english_highball.name: English Highball
cocktaildb:english_highball.instructions: Pour brandy, gin, and sweet vermouth into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water. Add the twist of lemon peel, stir, and serve. (Ginger ale may be substituted for carbonated water, if preferred.)

cocktaildb:the_philosopher.name: The Philosopher
cocktaildb:the_philosopher.instructions: Add all the spirits in a shaker (best to use Hendricks gin) as well as the orange bitters and lemon juice. Strain into a Margarita glass, top with Prosecco.

cocktaildb:zorbatini.name: Zorbatini
cocktaildb:zorbatini.instructions: Prepare like a Martini. Garnish with a green olive.

cocktaildb:casino.name: Casino
cocktaildb:casino.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain into chilled cocktail glass. Garnish with a lemon twist and a maraschino cherry. Serve without a straw.

iba::casino.name: Casino
iba::casino.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktails shaker, shake well with ice, strain\ninto chilled rocks glass with ice.
iba::casino.glass: into chilled rocks glass with ice.
iba::casino.garnish: Garnish with a lemon zest and a maraschino cherry.

cocktaildb:after_dinner_cocktail.name: After Dinner Cocktail
cocktaildb:after_dinner_cocktail.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except lime wedge) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the wedge of lime and serve.

cocktaildb:lady_love_fizz.name: Lady Love Fizz
cocktaildb:lady_love_fizz.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cocktaildb:bacardi_cocktail.name: Bacardi Cocktail
cocktaildb:bacardi_cocktail.instructions: Shake together with ice. Strain into glass and serve.

cocktaildb:gin_swizzle.name: Gin Swizzle
cocktaildb:gin_swizzle.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the lime juice, sugar, gin, and bitters. Shake well. Almost fill a colling glass with ice cubes. Stir until the glass is frosted. Strain the mixture in the shaker into the glass and add the club soda.

cocktaildb:new_york_sour.name: New York Sour
cocktaildb:new_york_sour.instructions: Shake blended whiskey, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Float claret on top. Decorate with the half-slice of lemon and the cherry and serve.

iba::new_york_sour.name: New York Sour
iba::new_york_sour.instructions: Pour all ingredients into the shaker. Shake vigorously with ice.\nStrain into a chilled rocks glass filled with ice. Float the wine on top.
iba::new_york_sour.glass: strain into a chilled rocks glass filled with ice. float the wine on top.
iba::new_york_sour.garnish: Garnish with lemon or orange zest with cherry.

cocktaildb:ace.name: Ace
cocktaildb:ace.instructions: Shake all the ingredients in a cocktail shaker and ice then strain in a cold glass.

cocktaildb:amaretto_sunrise.name: Amaretto Sunrise
cocktaildb:amaretto_sunrise.instructions: Mix together the amaretto and orange juice. Pour into glass and then add the grenadine untill you see the sunrise.

cocktaildb:blackthorn.name: Blackthorn
cocktaildb:blackthorn.instructions: Stir sloe gin and vermouth with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

cocktaildb:addison.name: Addison
cocktaildb:addison.instructions: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.

cocktaildb:absolutly_screwed_up.name: Absolutly Screwed Up
cocktaildb:absolutly_screwed_up.instructions: Shake it up it tasts better that way, but you can stir it if you want. 6 of those and you will be wasted for the rest of the night.

cocktaildb:kill_the_cold_smoothie.name: Kill the cold Smoothie
cocktaildb:kill_the_cold_smoothie.instructions: Juice ginger and lemon and add it to hot water. You may add cardomom.

cocktaildb:horse_s_neck.name: Horse's Neck
cocktaildb:horse_s_neck.instructions: Pour brandy and ginger ale directly into highball glass with ice cubes. Stir gently. Garnish with lemon zest. If desired, add dashes of Angostura Bitter.

cocktaildb:quentin.name: Quentin
cocktaildb:quentin.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, Kahlua, and cream. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the nutmeg.

cocktaildb:scooter.name: Scooter
cocktaildb:scooter.instructions: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktaildb:funk_and_soul.name: Funk and Soul
cocktaildb:funk_and_soul.instructions: Mix all ingredients together and strain into a Collins glass. Use Jamaican rum where possible for a more authentic taste.

cocktaildb:highland_fling_cocktail.name: Highland Fling Cocktail
cocktaildb:highland_fling_cocktail.instructions: Stir all ingredients (except olive) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the olive and serve.

cocktaildb:lord_and_lady.name: Lord And Lady
cocktaildb:lord_and_lady.instructions: Pour the rum and Tia Maria into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well.

cocktaildb:tennesee_mud.name: Tennesee Mud
cocktaildb:tennesee_mud.instructions: Mix Coffee, Jack Daniels and Amaretto. Add Cream on top.

cocktaildb:pornstar_martini.name: Pornstar Martini
cocktaildb:pornstar_martini.instructions: Straight: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled martini cocktail glass. Cut passion fruit in half and use as garnish. Pour prosecco into a chilled shot glass and serve alongside the martini.

cocktaildb:strawberry_daiquiri.name: Strawberry Daiquiri
cocktaildb:strawberry_daiquiri.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:arthur_tompkins.name: Arthur Tompkins
cocktaildb:arthur_tompkins.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the gin, Grand Marnier, and lemon juice. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the lemon twist.

cocktaildb:van_vleet.name: Van Vleet
cocktaildb:van_vleet.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.

cocktaildb:vodka_fizz.name: Vodka Fizz
cocktaildb:vodka_fizz.instructions: Blend all ingredients, save nutmeg. Pour into large white wine glass and sprinkle nutmeg on top.

cocktaildb:zipperhead.name: Zipperhead
cocktaildb:zipperhead.instructions: Fill glass with rocks, add straw before putting in liquor. Then add the ingredients in order, trying to keep layered as much as possible (i.e. Chambord on bottom, then Vodka, Then soda on top).

cocktaildb:midnight_cowboy.name: Midnight Cowboy
cocktaildb:midnight_cowboy.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:zippy_s_revenge.instructions: Mix Kool-Aid to taste then add Rum and ammaretto. shake well to disolve the sugar in the Kool-Aid... serve cold

cocktaildb:jewel_of_the_nile.name: Jewel Of The Nile
cocktaildb:jewel_of_the_nile.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:the_galah.name: The Galah
cocktaildb:the_galah.instructions: Mix together the alcoholic portions and top with Pineapple and Lime juice.

cocktaildb:derby.name: Derby
cocktaildb:derby.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a mixing glass with ice. Stir. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with a sprig of fresh mint in the drink.

cocktaildb:absinthe_2.instructions: Mix together and let sit a few days. Strain through a coffee filter. To serve mix 1 part absinthe to 4 parts water, add ice, enjoy.

cocktaildb:surf_city_lifesaver.name: Surf City Lifesaver
cocktaildb:surf_city_lifesaver.instructions: Lots of ice and soda top up in tall glass with cherry and a grin.

cocktaildb:screwdriver.name: Screwdriver

cocktaildb:pink_gin.name: Pink Gin
cocktaildb:pink_gin.instructions: Pour the bitters into a wine glass. Swirl the glass to coat the inside with the bitters, shake out the excess. Pour the gin into the glass. Do not add ice.

cocktaildb:grizzly_bear.name: Grizzly Bear
cocktaildb:grizzly_bear.instructions: Served over ice. Sounds nasty, but tastes great.

cocktaildb:3_wise_men.name: 3 Wise Men
cocktaildb:3_wise_men.instructions: put them them in a glass... and slam it to tha head.

cocktaildb:69_special.instructions: Pour 2 oz. gin. Add 4 oz. 7-up. Add Lemon Juice for flavor. If you are weak, top up glass with more 7-Up.

cocktaildb:bloody_punch.name: Bloody Punch
cocktaildb:bloody_punch.instructions:
Place the thawed strawberries in a large bowl. Mash them with a fork to ensure no large chunks.

In a punch bowl or pitcher, combine mashed strawberries, lime pulp and soda. Mix well.

Add blueberries and raisins. They will float and look like bugs in the punch.

Strain into cobbler glass. If served “On the rocks”, strain ingredients
into old fashioned glass filled with ice.

cocktaildb:raspberry_julep.instructions: Softly muddle the mint leaves and raspberry syrup in the bottom of the cup. Add crushed ice and Bourbon to the cup and then stir. Top with more ice, garnish with a mint sprig.

cocktaildb:angel_face.name: Angel Face

cocktaildb:poppy_cocktail.instructions: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktaildb:brave_bull_shooter.instructions: Pour Tabasco into bottom of shot glass and fill with tequila.

cocktaildb:jamaica_kiss.name: Jamaica Kiss
cocktaildb:jamaica_kiss.instructions: Fill a tumbler with ice cubes. Add a shot of Tia Maria and a shot of Jamaican light rum. Fill the tumbler with milk. Blend until smooth and serve immediately.

cocktaildb:501_blue.name: 501 Blue
cocktaildb:501_blue.instructions: Mix equal amounts into a glass with ice.

cocktaildb:chicago_fizz.name: Chicago Fizz

cocktaildb:mudslinger.name: Mudslinger
cocktaildb:mudslinger.instructions: Add all contents to a large jug or punch bowl. Stir well!

cocktaildb:gin_rickey.name: Gin Rickey
cocktaildb:gin_rickey.instructions: Half-fill a tall glass with ice. Mix the gin and Grenadine together and pour over the ice. Add the lime or lemon juice and top off with soda water. Decorate the glass with lime and/or lemon slices.

cocktaildb:hemingway_special.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice. Shake.

iba::hemingway_special.glass: shake well and strain into a large cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:apple_grande.instructions: Chill both ingredients!! Mix in a tumbler and enjoy!

cocktaildb:brandy_flip.name: Brandy Flip
cocktaildb:brandy_flip.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the brandy, egg, sugar, and cream. Shake well. Strain into a sour glass and garnish with the nutmeg.

cocktaildb:gentleman_s_club.name: Gentleman's Club
cocktaildb:gentleman_s_club.instructions: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well.

cocktaildb:vampiro.name: Vampiro
cocktaildb:vampiro.instructions: Vampiros may be made in a tall glass or an old fashioned glass. Bartenders may first "rim" the glass with Kosher Salt, which is done by placing a layer of Kosher Salt on a chopping board, moistening the glass' rim with lime juice or water, and then placing the upside down glass rim onto the Kosher Salt, so that the salt sticks to the moistened rim. The second step is to fill half the glass with ice and add one or two shooter glasses full of high quality Tequila. The next stage is to add the flavouring elements. This is done by squeezing a fresh lime into the glass, adding a few grains of salt, adding citrus-flavoured soda pop, until the glass is 4/5 full, and then adding spicy Viuda de Sanchez (or orange juice, lime juice and pico de gallo). The final step is to stir the ingredients so that the flavours are properly blended.

If each part is 1/2 oz then use about 2.5 cups of ice.

Blend it all together. 
Drink it with a big straw if you have one.

cocktaildb:tequila_sour.instructions: Shake tequila, juice of lemon, and powdered sugar with ice and strain into a whiskey sour glass. Add the half-slice of lemon, top with the cherry, and serve.

cocktaildb:artillery.name: Artillery

cocktaildb:abbey_cocktail.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except for the cherry) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the cherry and serve.

cocktaildb:orange_oasis.instructions: Shake brandy, gin, and orange juice with ice and strain into a highball glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

cocktaildb:mint_julep.instructions: In a highball glass gently muddle the mint, sugar and water. Fill the glass with cracked ice, add Bourbon and stir well until the glass is well frosted. Garnish with a mint sprig.

cocktaildb:pink_moon.instructions: Slowly shake in a shaker with ice, strain into a square whiskey glass. Top with fresh ice. Add the blackberries to garnish. Add flowers and a green leaf for a special look!

cocktaildb:dubonnet_cocktail.instructions: Stir all ingredients (except lemon peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of lemon peel and serve.

cocktaildb:lemouroudji.instructions: Juice the lemons. Peel and grate the ginger. Place the grated ginger and a liberal dash of the cayenne pepper into a piece of cheesecloth, and tie it into a knot. cocktaildb:radioactive_long_island_iced_.instructions: Pour all ingredients over ice in a very tall glass. Sip cautiously.

cocktaildb:turf_cocktail.name: Turf Cocktail
cocktaildb:turf_cocktail.instructions: Stir all ingredients (except orange peel) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Add the twist of orange peel and serve.

cocktaildb:barracuda.name: Barracuda
cocktaildb:barracuda.instructions: Shake pour ingredients with ice. Strain into glass, top with Sparkling wine.

cocktaildb:planter_s_punch.name: Planter's Punch
cocktaildb:planter_s_punch.instructions: Pour all ingredients, except the bitters, into shaker filled with ice. Shake well. Pour into large glass, filled with ice. Add Angostura bitters, "on top". Garnish with cocktail cherry and pineapple.

cocktaildb:747_drink.name: 747 Drink
cocktaildb:747_drink.instructions:
Fill a Collins glass with ice.
Pour in vodka, lime cordial, and cranberry juice.
Fill up with Sprite.
Garnish with a Lime wheel or some cranberries

cocktaildb:godchild.name: Godchild
cocktaildb:godchild.instructions: Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice, strain into a champagne flute, and serve.

cocktaildb:port_wine_cocktail.name: Port Wine Cocktail
cocktaildb:port_wine_cocktail.instructions: Stir ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktaildb:munich_mule.name: Munich Mule
cocktaildb:munich_mule.instructions:
Fill glass with ice
Pour Gin and Lime Juice
Fill glass with Ginger Beer
Garnish with Cucumer and Lime slice

cocktaildb:a1.name: A1
cocktaildb:a1.instructions: Pour all ingredients into a cocktail shaker, mix and serve over ice into a chilled glass.

cocktaildb:atomic_lokade.name: Atomic Lokade
cocktaildb:atomic_lokade.instructions: In a shaker, place lemonade, vodka, blue Curacao, and triple sec together. Shake with ice and strain into glass. Add sugar to taste

cocktaildb:cosmopolitan.name: Cosmopolitan
cocktaildb:cosmopolitan.instructions: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and double strain into large cocktail glass. Garnish with lime wheel.

iba::cosmopolitan.name: Cosmopolitan
iba::cosmopolitan.instructions: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice.\nShake well and strain into large cocktail glass.
iba::cosmopolitan.glass: shake well and strain into large cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:arizona_antifreeze.name: Arizona Antifreeze
cocktaildb:arizona_antifreeze.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shot glass and slam !!!!

cocktaildb:thriller.name: Thriller
cocktaildb:thriller.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:57_chevy_with_a_white_license.name: 57 Chevy with a White License Plate
cocktaildb:57_chevy_with_a_white_license.instructions: 1. Fill a rocks glass with ice 2.add white creme de cacao and vodka 3.stir

cocktaildb:3_mile_long_island_iced_tea.name: 3-Mile Long Island Iced Tea
cocktaildb:3_mile_long_island_iced_tea.instructions: Fill 14oz glass with ice and alcohol. Fill 2/3 glass with cola and remainder with sweet & sour. Top with dash of bitters and lemon wedge.

cocktaildb:frozen_pineapple_daiquiri.name: Frozen Pineapple Daiquiri
cocktaildb:frozen_pineapple_daiquiri.instructions: Combine all ingredients with 1 cup of crushed ice in an electric blender. Blend at a low speed for a short length of time. Pour into a cocktail glass and serve.

cocktaildb:brain_fart.name: Brain Fart
cocktaildb:brain_fart.instructions: Mix all ingredients together. Slowly and gently. Works best if ice is added to punch bowl and soda's are very cold.

cocktaildb:london_town.name: London Town
cocktaildb:london_town.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:whitecap_margarita.name: Whitecap Margarita
cocktaildb:whitecap_margarita.instructions: Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth. This makes one drink.

cocktaildb:french_negroni.name: French Negroni
cocktaildb:french_negroni.instructions:
Add ice to a shaker and pour in all ingredients.
Using a bar spoon, stir 40 to 45 revolutions or until thoroughly chilled.
Strain into a martini glass or over ice into a rocks glass. Garnish with orange twist.

cocktaildb:garibaldi_negroni.name: Garibaldi Negroni
cocktaildb:garibaldi_negroni.instructions: Mix together in a shaker and garnish with a simple orange slice. Fill your vitamin C and cocktail fix at the same time!

cocktaildb:rum_runner.name: Rum Runner
cocktaildb:rum_runner.instructions: Mix all ingredients in glass & add ice.

cocktaildb:happy_skipper.name: Happy Skipper
cocktaildb:happy_skipper.instructions: Pour Captain Morgan's Spiced Rum over ice, fill glass to top with Ginger Ale. Garnish with lime. Tastes like a cream soda. Named for the Gilligan's Island reference ("The Captain" *in* "Ginger" is a Happy Skipper!)

cocktaildb:harvey_wallbanger.name: Harvey Wallbanger
cocktaildb:harvey_wallbanger.instructions: Stir the vodka and orange juice with ice in the glass, then float the Galliano on top. Garnish and serve.

cocktaildb:orange_rosemary_collins.name: Orange Rosemary Collins
cocktaildb:orange_rosemary_collins.instructions: Add the spirits to the bottom of the glass and top equally with the mixer drinks. Garnish with orange slices inside the glass as well as some rosemary on top.

cocktaildb:pure_passion.name: Pure Passion
cocktaildb:pure_passion.instructions: Mix up all ingredients with a cocktail stirrer and serve with crushed ice with mint and edible flour if available.

cocktaildb:absolut_evergreen.name: Absolut Evergreen
cocktaildb:absolut_evergreen.instructions: Mix, pour over ice and top up with Bitter Lemon.

cocktaildb:banana_daiquiri.name: Banana Daiquiri
cocktaildb:banana_daiquiri.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes. Shake well. Strain in chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:sol_y_sombra.name: Sol Y Sombra
cocktaildb:sol_y_sombra.instructions: Shake ingredients with ice, strain into a brandy snifter, and serve. (The English translation of the name of this drink is "Sun and Shade", and after sampling this drink, you'll understand why. Thanks, Kirby.)

cocktaildb:gideon_s_green_dinosaur.name: Gideon's Green Dinosaur
cocktaildb:gideon_s_green_dinosaur.instructions: Add all ingredients in collins glass with ice and stir.

cocktaildb:a_midsummernight_dream.name: A midsummernight dream
cocktaildb:a_midsummernight_dream.instructions: Mix the strawberrys in a blender Pour it together with the vodka,kirch and strawberry liquer over ice in a shaker. Shake well and pour in a highballglass. Fill up with the Russchian water

cocktaildb:9_1_2_weeks.name: 9 1/2 Weeks
cocktaildb:9_1_2_weeks.instructions: Combine all ingredients in glass mixer. Chill and strain into Cocktail glass. Garnish with sliced strawberry.

cocktaildb:blue_mountain.name: Blue Mountain
cocktaildb:blue_mountain.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Shake well. Strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes.

cocktaildb:avalon.name: Avalon
cocktaildb:avalon.instructions: Fill a tall glass with ice. Layer the Finlandia Vodka, lemon and apple juices, Pisang Ambon, and top up with lemonade. Stir slightly and garnish with a spiralled cucumber skin and a red cherry. The cucumber provides zest and looks attractive. This drink, created by Timo Haimi, took first prize in the 1991 Finlandia Vodka Long Drink Competition.

cocktaildb:black_forest_shake.name: Black Forest Shake
cocktaildb:black_forest_shake.instructions: In a blender put ice cubes, chocolate syrup, cherry brandy, vodka, and milk. Blend very well.

cocktaildb:atlantic_sun.name: Atlantic Sun
cocktaildb:atlantic_sun.instructions: Shake all the ingredients, top the drink with soda. Garnish with a slice of orange.

cocktaildb:margarita.name: Margarita
cocktaildb:margarita.instructions: Rub the rim of the glass with the lime slice to make the salt stick to it. Take care to moisten only the outer rim and sprinkle the salt on it. The salt should present to the lips of the imbiber and never mix into the cocktail. Shake the other ingredients with ice, then carefully pour into the glass.

iba::margarita.name: Margarita
iba::margarita.instructions: Add all ingredients into a shaker with ice.\nShake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba::margarita.glass: shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:flying_scotchman.name: Flying Scotchman
cocktaildb:flying_scotchman.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktaildb:paradise.name: Paradise
cocktaildb:paradise.instructions: Shake together over ice. Strain into cocktail glass and serve chilled.

iba::paradise.name: Paradise
iba::paradise.instructions: Pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.
iba::paradise.glass: pour all ingredients into cocktail shaker, shake well with ice, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:a_day_at_the_beach.name: A Day at the Beach
cocktaildb:a_day_at_the_beach.instructions: Shake Rum, Amaretto, and Orange Juice in a shaker filled with ice. Strain over ice into a highball glass. Add Grenadine and garnish with a Pineapple Wedge and a Strawberry.

cocktaildb:adam_sunrise.name: Adam Sunrise
cocktaildb:adam_sunrise.instructions: Fill blender up with ice. Fill half with Bartons Vodka. Put 10 tsp of sugar, add 1/2 can lemonade concentrate, fill to top with water. Blend for 60 seconds.

cocktaildb:snowday.name: Snowday
cocktaildb:snowday.instructions: Stir all ingredients with ice. Strain into a chilled rocks glass over fresh ice. Express orange peel over drink and garnish.

cocktaildb:strawberry_margarita.name: Strawberry Margarita
cocktaildb:strawberry_margarita.instructions: Rub rim of cocktail glass with lemon juice and dip rim in salt. Shake schnapps, tequila, triple sec, lemon juice, and strawberries with ice, strain into the salt-rimmed glass, and serve.

cocktaildb:amaretto_rose.name: Amaretto Rose
cocktaildb:amaretto_rose.instructions: Pour amaretto and lime juice over ice in a collins glass. Fill with club soda and serve.

cocktaildb:french_connection.name: French Connection
cocktaildb:french_connection.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes. Stir gently.

iba::french_connection.name: French Connection
iba::french_connection.instructions: Pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.\nStir gently.
iba::french_connection.glass: pour all ingredients directly into old fashioned glass filled with ice cubes.

cocktaildb:vesuvio.name: Vesuvio
cocktaildb:vesuvio.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes, and serve.

cocktaildb:cocktail_horses_neck.name: Cocktail Horse’s Neck
cocktaildb:cocktail_horses_neck.instructions:
Wash and brush an organic, untreated lemon, then cut a spiral of lemon peel, using a citrus peel. If it is too large, cut it with a sharp knife.

Put some ice in a tall tumbler glass, place the lemon peel inside and pour the cognac, add the ginger beer and let 2-3 drops of Angostura fall into it. Easy to do, but once you try it you'll love it.

cocktaildb:tequila_fizz.name: Tequila Fizz
cocktaildb:tequila_fizz.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except ginger ale) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes. Fill with ginger ale, stir, and serve.

cocktaildb:brandy_alexander.name: Brandy Alexander
cocktaildb:brandy_alexander.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except nutmeg) with ice and strain contents into a cocktail glass. Sprinkle nutmeg on top and serve.

cocktaildb:imperial_fizz.name: Imperial Fizz
cocktaildb:imperial_fizz.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except carbonated water) with ice and strain into a highball glass over two ice cubes. Fill with carbonated water, stir, and serve.

cocktaildb:kool_aid_shot.name: Kool-Aid Shot
cocktaildb:kool_aid_shot.instructions: Pour into a large glass with ice and stir. Add a little cranberry juice to taste.

cocktaildb:whisky_mac.name: Whisky Mac
cocktaildb:whisky_mac.instructions: Pour both of the ingredients into a wine goblet with no ice.

cocktaildb:orange_crush.name: Orange Crush
cocktaildb:orange_crush.instructions: Add all ingredients to tumbler-Pour as shot

cocktaildb:jelly_bean.name: Jelly Bean
cocktaildb:jelly_bean.instructions: mix equal parts in pony glass-tastes just like a jelly bean!

cocktaildb:irish_russian.name: Irish Russian
cocktaildb:irish_russian.instructions: Add the ingredients in the order listed in the recipe. Care must be taken when adding the Guinness to prevent an excess of foam. Do Not add ice.

cocktaildb:151_florida_bushwacker.name: 151 Florida Bushwacker
cocktaildb:151_florida_bushwacker.instructions: Combine all ingredients. Blend until smooth. Garnish with chocolate shavings if desired.

cocktaildb:orange_push_up.name: Orange Push-up
cocktaildb:orange_push_up.instructions: Combine liquors in a blender. Add a half scoop of ice and blend. Garnish with an orange and cherry flag. So good it will melt in your mouth!!!

cocktaildb:cuba_libre.name: Cuba Libre
cocktaildb:cuba_libre.instructions: Build all ingredients in a Collins glass filled with ice. Garnish with lime wedge.

iba::cuba_libre.name: Cuba Libre
iba::cuba_libre.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
iba::cuba_libre.glass: build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.

cocktaildb:gimlet.name: Gimlet
cocktaildb:gimlet.instructions:
Add all the ingredients to a shaker and fill with ice.

Shake, and strain into a chilled cocktail glass or an Old Fashioned glass filled with fresh ice.

Garnish with a lime wheel.

cocktaildb:between_the_sheets.name: Between The Sheets
cocktaildb:between_the_sheets.instructions: Pour all ingredients into shaker with ice cubes, shake, strain into chilled cocktail glass.

iba::between_the_sheets.name: Between the Sheets
iba::between_the_sheets.instructions: Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker.\nShake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba::between_the_sheets.glass: shake with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:berry_deadly.name: Berry Deadly
cocktaildb:berry_deadly.instructions: Add all ingredients to large bowl. Stir gently. Serve chilled.

cocktaildb:gagliardo.name: Gagliardo
cocktaildb:gagliardo.instructions: Shake well and serve in a cocktail glass. This is a home cocktail of American/Internet Bar del Pozzo, Pavia, Italy.

cocktaildb:tequila_sunrise.name: Tequila Sunrise
cocktaildb:tequila_sunrise.instructions: Pour the tequila and orange juice into glass over ice. Add the grenadine, which will sink to the bottom. Stir gently to create the sunrise effect. Garnish and serve.

iba::tequila_sunrise.name: Tequila Sunrise
iba::tequila_sunrise.instructions: Pour tequila and orange juice directly into highball glass filled with ice cubes.\nAdd the grenadine syrup to create chromatic effect (sunrise), do not stir.
iba::tequila_sunrise.glass: pour tequila and orange juice directly into highball glass filled with ice cubes.
iba::tequila_sunrise.garnish: Garnish with half orange slice or an orange zest.

cocktaildb:texas_sling.name: Texas Sling
cocktaildb:texas_sling.instructions: Blend with Ice until smooth. Serve in a tulip glass, top with whip cream.

cocktaildb:aztec_punch.name: Aztec Punch
cocktaildb:aztec_punch.instructions: Mix all ingredients in a pitcher. Mix thoroughly and pour into whatever is available, the bigger the better! This drink packs a big punch, so don't over do it.

cocktaildb:oreo_mudslide.name: Oreo Mudslide
cocktaildb:oreo_mudslide.instructions: Blend Vodka, Kahlua, Bailey's, ice-cream and the Oreo well in a blender. Pour into a large frosted glass. Garnish with whipped cream and a cherry.

cocktaildb:dark_and_stormy.name: Dark and Stormy
cocktaildb:dark_and_stormy.instructions: In a highball glass filled with ice add 6cl dark rum and top with ginger beer. Garnish with lime wedge.

cocktaildb:amaretto_shake.name: Amaretto Shake
cocktaildb:amaretto_shake.instructions: Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend at high speed until smooth. Serve in chilled glass garnished with bittersweet chocolate shavings.

cocktaildb:rum_cooler.name: Rum Cooler
cocktaildb:rum_cooler.instructions: Pour the rum and soda into a collins glass almost filled with ice cubes. Stir well and garnish with the lemon wedge.

cocktaildb:vodka_russian.name: Vodka Russian
cocktaildb:vodka_russian.instructions: Mix it as a ordinary drink .

cocktaildb:absolut_limousine.name: Absolut limousine
cocktaildb:absolut_limousine.instructions: Fill Absolut into a glass. Add Lime juice. Add Ice and lime wedges.

cocktaildb:mojito.name: Mojito
cocktaildb:mojito.instructions: Muddle mint leaves with sugar and lime juice. Add a splash of soda water and fill the glass with cracked ice. Pour the rum and top with soda water. Garnish and serve with straw.

iba::mojito.name: Mojito
iba::mojito.instructions: Mix mint springs with sugar and lime juice.\nAdd splash of soda water and fill the glass with ice.\nPour the rum and top with soda water. Light stir to involve all ingredients.
iba::mojito.glass: add splash of soda water and fill the glass with ice.
iba::mojito.garnish: Garnish with sprigs of mint and slice of lime.

cocktaildb:damned_if_you_do.name: Damned if you do
cocktaildb:damned_if_you_do.instructions: Pour into shot glass. Put in mouth. Repeat as deemed necessary.

cocktaildb:army_special.name: Army special
cocktaildb:army_special.instructions: Pour Vodka, Gin and lime cordial into glass, and top up with crushed ice. Wait for ice to melt slightly and sip without a straw.

cocktaildb:amaretto_stone_sour_alternati.name: Amaretto Stone Sour Alternative
cocktaildb:amaretto_stone_sour_alternati.instructions: Shake sour mix, tequila and amaretto with ice. Strain into highball glass. Add a splash of OJ. Garnish with orange slice and a cherry.

cocktaildb:kiwi_martini.name: Kiwi Martini
cocktaildb:kiwi_martini.instructions:
The kiwi martini is a very fun vodka cocktail and it is one of the best drinks that makes use of fresh fruit. Though there are a few recipes floating around, this is one of the easiest and it is an absolutely delightful green martini to drink.

For this recipe, you'll simply muddle slices of kiwi with simple syrup, then shake it with vodka. It's a drink that anyone can mix up in minutes and a perfect cocktail to show off your favorite vodka.

cocktaildb:imperial_cocktail.name: Imperial Cocktail
cocktaildb:imperial_cocktail.instructions: Shake with ice and strain into cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:tipperary.name: Tipperary
cocktaildb:tipperary.instructions: Stir over ice. Strain into chilled glass. Cut a wide swath of orange peel, and express the orange oils over the drink. Discard orange twist.

iba::tipperary.name: Tipperary
iba::tipperary.instructions: Pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.\nStir well. Strain into chilled martini cocktail glass.
iba::tipperary.glass: pour all ingredients into mixing glass with ice cubes.
iba::tipperary.garnish: Garnish with a slice of orange.

cocktaildb:apricot_punch.name: Apricot punch
cocktaildb:apricot_punch.instructions: Pour all ingrediants into a large punch bowl. Add ice and 4 oranges that are peeled and divided.

cocktaildb:aviation.name: Aviation
cocktaildb:aviation.instructions: Add all ingredients into cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake well and strain into cocktail glass. Garnish with a cherry.

iba::aviation.name: Aviation
iba::aviation.instructions: Add all ingredients into a cocktail shaker.\nShake with cracked ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.
iba::aviation.glass: shake with cracked ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:sea_breeze.name: Sea breeze
cocktaildb:sea_breeze.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice. Garnish with lime wedge.

iba::sea_breeze.name: Sea Breeze
iba::sea_breeze.instructions: Build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
iba::sea_breeze.glass: build all ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice.
iba::sea_breeze.garnish: Garnish with an orange zest and cherry.

cocktaildb:scotch_cobbler.name: Scotch Cobbler
cocktaildb:scotch_cobbler.instructions: Pour scotch, brandy, and curacao over ice in an old-fashioned glass. Add the orange slice, top with the mint sprig, and serve.

cocktaildb:french_75.name: French 75
cocktaildb:french_75.instructions: Combine gin, sugar, and lemon juice in a cocktail shaker filled with ice. Shake vigorously and strain into a chilled champagne glass. Top up with Champagne. Stir gently.

iba::french_75.name: French 75
iba::french_75.instructions:
Pour all the ingredients, except Champagne, into a shaker.
Shake well and strain into a Champagne flute.
Top up with Champagne.
Stir gently.

cocktaildb:110_in_the_shade.name: 110 in the shade
cocktaildb:110_in_the_shade.instructions: Drop shooter in glass. Fill with beer

cocktaildb:cherry_rum.name: Cherry Rum
cocktaildb:cherry_rum.instructions: Shake all ingredients with ice, strain into a cocktail glass, and serve.

cocktaildb:cream_soda.name: Cream Soda
cocktaildb:cream_soda.instructions: Pour 1oz of Spiced Rum into a highball glass with ice. Fill with Ginger Ale.

cocktaildb:adios_amigos_cocktail.name: Adios Amigos Cocktail
cocktaildb:adios_amigos_cocktail.instructions: Shake together all the ingredients and strain into a cold glass.

cocktaildb:apricot_lady.name: Apricot Lady
cocktaildb:apricot_lady.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the rum, apricot brandy, triple sec, lemon juice, and egg white. Shake well. Strain into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes. Garnish with the orange slice.

cocktaildb:martinez_cocktail.name: Martinez Cocktail
cocktaildb:martinez_cocktail.instructions: Stir all ingredients (except cherry) with ice and strain into a cocktail glass. Top with the cherry and serve.

cocktaildb:a_night_in_old_mandalay.name: A Night In Old Mandalay
cocktaildb:a_night_in_old_mandalay.instructions: In a shaker half-filled with ice cubes, combine the light rum, añejo rum, orange juice, and lemon juice. Shake well. Strain into a highball glass almost filled with ice cubes. Top with the ginger ale. Garnish with the lemon twist.

cocktaildb:absolut_summertime.name: Absolut Summertime
cocktaildb:absolut_summertime.instructions: Add all ingredients except lemon to shaker filled with ice. Cover and shake vigorously. Strain contents into ice filled collins glass. Garnish with lemon.

cocktaildb:loch_lomond.name: Loch Lomond
cocktaildb:loch_lomond.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with ice cubes, combine the Scotch, Drambuie, and vermouth. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass. Garnish with the lemon twist.

cocktaildb:captain_kidd_s_punch.name: Captain Kidd's Punch
cocktaildb:captain_kidd_s_punch.instructions: Mix all ingredients together in a shaker and strain into a collins glass. Use Caribbean dark Rum for a sweeter taste.

cocktaildb:victory_collins.name: Victory Collins
cocktaildb:victory_collins.instructions: Shake all ingredients (except orange slice) with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes. Add the slice of orange and serve.

cocktaildb:ruby_tuesday.name: Ruby Tuesday
cocktaildb:ruby_tuesday.instructions: Pour gin and cranberry into a highball filled with ice cubes. Add grenadine and stir.

cocktaildb:lone_tree_cooler.name: Lone Tree Cooler
cocktaildb:lone_tree_cooler.instructions: Stir powdered sugar and 2 oz. carbonated water in a collins glass. Fill glass with ice, add gin and vermouth, and stir. Fill with carbonated water and stir again. Add the twist of lemon peel and the orange spiral so that the end dangles over rim of glass.

cocktaildb:acapulco.name: Acapulco
cocktaildb:acapulco.instructions: Combine and shake all ingredients (except mint) with ice and strain into an old-fashioned glass over ice cubes. Add the sprig of mint and serve.

cocktaildb:tommy_s_margarita.name: Tommy's Margarita
cocktaildb:tommy_s_margarita.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:kamikaze.name: Kamikaze
cocktaildb:kamikaze.instructions: Shake all ingredients together with ice. Strain into glass, garnish and serve.

cocktaildb:archbishop.name: Archbishop
cocktaildb:archbishop.instructions: In an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes, combine all of the ingredients. Stir well.

cocktaildb:pineapple_paloma.name: Pineapple Paloma
cocktaildb:pineapple_paloma.instructions:
Rub the rim of each glass with lime slice and dip into salt.
Add ice, tequila, grapefruit juice, lime juice and top with pineapple soda.
Give it a quick stir.
Garnish with fresh pineapple or lime.

cocktaildb:flaming_dr_pepper.name: Flaming Dr. Pepper
cocktaildb:flaming_dr_pepper.instructions: Add Amaretto, Bacardi, and vodka. Mix in the Dr. Pepper and beer

cocktaildb:the_strange_weaver.name: The Strange Weaver
cocktaildb:the_strange_weaver.instructions: Mix ingredients slowly in a glass with ice, garnish with orange slice

cocktaildb:bluebird.name: Bluebird
cocktaildb:bluebird.instructions: In a mixing glass half-filled with crushed ice, combine the gin, triple sec, Curacao, and bitters. Stir well. Strain into a cocktail glass and garnish with the lemon twist and the cherry.

cocktaildb:lemon_drop.name: Lemon Drop
cocktaildb:lemon_drop.instructions: Shake and strain into a chilled cocktail glass rimmed with sugar.

cocktaildb:gin_basil_smash.name: Gin Basil Smash
cocktaildb:gin_basil_smash.instructions:
Muddle Basil leaves (~ 10) with Suggar Syrup in a shaker. Add Gin an Lemon Juice.
Filter and serve in a tumbler with ice

iba::gin_basil_smash.name: Gin Basil Smash
iba::gin_basil_smash.instructions: Add all ingredients into shaker with ice.\nShake vigorously and pour into chilled cocktail glass.
iba::gin_basil_smash.glass: shake vigorously and pour into chilled cocktail glass.

cocktaildb:kool_aid_slammer.name: Kool-Aid Slammer
cocktaildb:kool_aid_slammer.instructions: Fill half the shot glass with the kool-aid first. Then put a paper towel over the top of the glass and slowly pour in the vodka. If you do it right, you should be able to see that the two liquids are separated, with the vodka on top. Now slam it! The last thing you'll taste is the kool-aid.

cocktaildb:adam_bomb.name: Adam Bomb
cocktaildb:adam_bomb.instructions: Add ice to blender (or to glass if prefer on the rocks) then fruit, and fruite juice depending on personal prefference then add the Rum, Vodka, Tequila, and triple sec. blend till smooth, rim glass with sugar or salt and pour mixture in. garnish with lemon or lime slice.

cocktaildb:moscow_mule.name: Moscow Mule
cocktaildb:moscow_mule.instructions: Combine vodka and ginger beer in a highball glass filled with ice. Add lime juice. Stir gently. Garnish.

cocktaildb:ramos_gin_fizz.name: Ramos Gin Fizz

Prepare all the ingredients on the counter to be able to work well and quickly, especially the cream and egg white.

Pour all the ingredients into a shaker.

Shake vigorously for 1 minute: cream and egg white must be mixed perfectly, so don't rush.

Now open the shaker and put some ice and shake for 1-2 minutes. It depends on how long you can resist!

Pour into a highball glass, add a splash of soda and garnish to taste.

Ramos Gin Fizz was once drunk as an invigorating drink or even as a breakfast, try it as an aperitif and after dinner and you will discover a little gem now lost.

iba::penicillin.name: Penicillin
iba::penicillin.instructions:
Muddle fresh ginger in a shaker and add the remaining ingredients except for the Islay single malt whisky.
Fill the shaker with ice and shake.
Fine train into a chilled Old Fashioned glass with ice.
Float the single malt whisky on top.

iba::remember_the_maine.name: Remember the Maine
iba::remember_the_maine.instructions: Pour the absinthe into a coupe glass and swirl to completely coat the inside.\nDiscard the absinthe and set the glass aside. Add the other ingredients to a mixing glass and fill it 3/4 full with ice. Stir until chilled, then strain into the glass rinsed with the absinthe.

iba::sazerac.name: Sazerac
iba::sazerac.instructions: Rinse a chilled old-fashioned glass with the absinthe, add crushed ice and set it aside. Stir the remaining ingredients over ice in a mixing glass.\nDiscard the ice and any excess absinthe from the prepared glass, strain the mixed drink into the glass.\nNOTE: The original recipe changed after the American Civil War, Rye Whiskey substituted Cognac as it became hard to obtain.
iba::sazerac.glass: discard the ice and any excess absinthe from the prepared glass, strain the mixed drink into the glass.

iba::caipirinha.instructions: Place lime and sugar into a double old fashioned glass and muddle gently.\nFill the glass with cracked ice and add Cachaça. Stir gently to involve ingredients.\nNote: Caipiroska – Instead of Cachaça use Vodka; Caipirissima – Instead of Cachaça use Rum. Caipirão – Instead of Cachaça use Licor Beirão.

iba::ramos_fizz.name: Ramos Fizz
iba::ramos_fizz.instructions:
Pour all ingredients except soda water in a cocktail shaker with ice.
Shake for two minutes, double strain in a glass, pour the drink back in the shaker and hard shake without ice for one minute.
Strain into a highball glass, top up with soda.
NOTE: The drink was invented by Henry Ramos in 1888, at his bar Meyer’s Table d’Hôtel Internationale in New Orleans. The Ramos Fizz was originally shaken for 12 minutes by a crew of 30 bartenders who passed the shaker from one to another.
iba::ramos_fizz.glass: strain into a highball glass, top up with soda.
